title: Obliquity
summary: OBLIQ'UITY, noun [Latin obliquitas.] 1. Deviation from a right line; deviation from parallelism or perpendicularity; as the obliquity of the ecliptic to the equator. 2. Deviation from moral rectitude.

inlines.v: OBLIQ'UITY, noun [Latin obliquitas.] 1. Deviation from a right line; deviation from parallelism or perpendicularity; as the obliquity of the ecliptic to the equator. 2. Deviation from moral rectitude. To disobey God or oppose his will in any thing imports a moral obliquity 3. Irregularity; deviation from ordinary rules.
